sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Of the 30 units, a minimum of 15 must be CRIM courses numbered 300/400 and the remaining from any upper division on-campus or distance education courses, or a combination of both.

sections.note:
completion of lower division prerequisite courses CRIM 101, 131 and 135
successful completion of an approved program comprised of 30 units of third and fourth year courses
minimum 2.5 GPA on courses applied toward the diploma
completion of the diploma within five years of admission to the program
For information, contact the advisor in criminology.

sections.title: Application Deadlines

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must make separate application for admission to the University, in accordance with University deadlines for the appropriate term.

sections.note: Applications received by the school after the deadline will be considered only if resources permit following consideration of those applications received on time.

grades.label: Admission, Program Declaration, and Continuation
grades.text: To continue in the program, students must maintain a 2.25 CGPA.

grades.label: Admission, Program Declaration, and Continuation
grades.text: Students whose CGPA falls below 2.25 cannot enroll in any upper division CRIM courses.

grades.label: Program Requirements
grades.text: completion of lower division prerequisite courses CRIM 101, 131 and 135 successful completion of an approved program comprised of 30 units of third and fourth year courses of the 30 units, a minimum of 15 must be CRIM courses numbered 300/400 and the remaining from any upper division on-campus or distance education courses, or a combination of both minimum 2.5 GPA on courses applied toward the diploma completion of the diploma within five years of admission to the program For information, contact the advisor in criminology.

grades.label: Upper Division Course Access
grades.text: Students with a minimum 2.25 CGPA are eligible to enroll in upper division criminology courses upon post baccalaureate diploma declaration.

grades.label: Graduation Requirements
grades.text: In addition to normal university grade point average requirements, the School of Criminology requires the following: for graduation, students must obtain a minimum 2.25 CGPA, 2.25 UDGPA, 2.25 criminology course CGPA (calculated on all CRIM courses completed at SFU), and 2.25 criminology course UDGPA (calculated on all upper division CRIM courses completed at SFU).
